metadata_caption: It’s FINALLY finished! 🎉❤️ Backstory ::: Kay and our nursery had a love-hate relationship. During her pregnancy, she tried to get the nursery put together, but with the limited space. It was hard to fit all the baby things into the room while still putting the nursery together. I noticed that the nursery got backed up full of boxes, and so once when she was out, I cleaned it all up and gave her a fresh start to make the nursery! Kay then added so many details to the room to make it into her dream nursery. As she approached her due date, we ran out of time to finish it. So when we got back, while Kay was taking care of Ellie, I got into the nursery and finished it off! It’s finally done! 😂 Kay decorated it so well! It looks amazing! I’m so happy for her because she put so much time into researching the perfect baby stuff, so I’m glad that it turned out just how she wanted it! Now we can make many many memories with Ellie in this room! (Most of which will be stinky) 😂 #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum
